title: Pixel
look: Big pixels, a limited palette and motion that steps at 8 fps.

doc.essence: A sprite from an old console: chunky pixels, few colours, steps instead of tweens.
doc.shapes: The whole drawing goes through a pixelate filter (4 px blocks); sizes snap to the 4 px grid, corners are nearly square, hands are round knobs and feet are blocks.
doc.eyes: Eyes and mouth are built from 4 px blocks (2 × 3 per eye, one shine block), so the pixelate filter never drops them.
pitfalls: SVG filters cost more than plain shapes: check the budget on phones.
